title: Ashvale Rising
author: Freya Hartwell
blurb: Jonah Eastwick, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
